dedupeText: urban grit album cover urban gritty distressed typography low key lighting industrial portrait teal and orange subject positioned on the left third looking into the dark negative space on the right contrast between the bright white shirt and the deep shadows of the background textual alignment with the horizontal lines of the industrial stairs in the background cool teal tinted shadows contrasting with warm skin tones combine a high contrast urban portrait with a heavy weathered sans serif display font and a clean colored subtitle all set within a teal tinted low key environment

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key, moody portrait of a man leaning against a brick wall in an industrial setting, featuring high-contrast lighting and distressed, sans-serif typography positioned in the dark negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the left third, looking into the dark negative space on the right.
Contrast between the bright white shirt and the deep shadows of the background.
Textual alignment with the horizontal lines of the industrial stairs in the background.
Cool teal-tinted shadows contrasting with warm skin tones.
coreInvariants: Distressed/weathered texture on the primary display text.
Low-key lighting with significant fall-off into black.
Industrial textures like brick and metal stairs.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male subject occupying the left 40% of the frame, leaning against a vertical brick edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and white shirt provide the primary focal point due to high value contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze to the right, landing on the primary typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large area of dark, textured negative space on the right half containing the text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted teal/cyan (secondary text and shadow tint).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject's shirt and the environment.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Randomized erosion patterns to simulate weathered paint on metal.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy distressed display font paired with a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif for contrast in texture and color.
graphicDevices: Horizontal lines from stairs acting as a grid for text placement.

preserve: Distressed texture of the main name
Teal color for the secondary line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold nature of the primary text.
Provides the clean, condensed skeleton for the display text before distressing.
Suitable for the secondary subtitle text when tracked out.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a moody, low-key portrait of a man with blonde hair and a goatee, wearing a dark leather jacket over a white t-shirt and blue jeans. He is leaning against a dark brick wall on the left, looking right. The right side of the frame features dark, industrial metal stairs in deep shadow with a teal color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in large, white, distressed condensed sans-serif uppercase letters in the center-right. Below it, add the secondary title in a smaller, clean, teal sans-serif font with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the subject looking toward the text?
Is the primary text visibly weathered/distressed?
Is the color palette dominated by teal and black?
Is the white shirt the brightest point of the image?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the teal color grade
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite distress.
Check that the teal tint doesn't wash out skin tones.
Verify the subject is positioned off-center.
Confirm the background stairs are subtle and don't distract from the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast urban portrait with a heavy, weathered sans-serif display font and a clean, colored subtitle, all set within a teal-tinted, low-key environment.
